title: Add account recovery via user-defined security questions (2+ required)

requirements.text: Extend the backend user account data to support user-defined security questions that are set up on first sign-in: store at least two question/answer pairs per principal and expose whether the caller has completed security-question setup.

quotes: choose there own and 2 ore more required they should be set up during sign up

acceptanceCriteria: Backend persists a per-principal security-question configuration separate from (or in addition to) the existing UserProfile record.
Caller can query a boolean status indicating whether they have completed security-question setup.
Backend enforces a minimum of 2 security questions when saving setup.
Answer data is not stored in plaintext (store a non-reversible representation such as a salted hash).

requirements.text: Add backend endpoints to (a) set initial security questions for the authenticated caller and (b) verify answers for the authenticated caller, enabling a recovery flow that allows the caller to reset/change their security questions after successful verification.

quotes: Add password reset flow using security questions (user-defined; require 2+; set up during signup; no email)

acceptanceCriteria: There is a backend method to set/replace the caller’s security questions, rejecting inputs with fewer than 2 questions.
There is a backend method to verify the caller’s submitted answers against the stored answers and return success/failure without revealing stored answers.
Unauthorized callers (not authenticated / lacking required permission) are rejected consistently with existing access-control patterns.

requirements.text: Add a frontend “Security Questions Setup” step that occurs during initial onboarding (interpreted as the user’s first successful Internet Identity sign-in): if the authenticated user has not set security questions yet, prompt them to create at least two custom questions and answers before continuing to the dashboard/camera experience.

quotes: they should be set up during sign up

acceptanceCriteria: After Internet Identity login, the app checks backend security-question setup status.
If not set up, the user is routed to or shown a dedicated setup UI that requires at least two Q/A entries and validates required fields.
On successful save, the user can proceed to the dashboard and protected routes as normal.
All user-facing text is in English and does not imply CloudCam AI can reset an Internet Identity password.

requirements.text: Add a frontend “Account Recovery” page for authenticated users that verifies their security-question answers and, upon success, allows them to reset/change their security questions (no email flow).

quotes: we can add password‑reset support next

acceptanceCriteria: There is a UI route/page accessible to authenticated users where they can answer their security questions.
If verification succeeds, the UI allows the user to set new security questions (minimum 2) and saves them via the backend.
If verification fails, the UI shows a clear error state without leaking which answers were incorrect.
No email, SMS, or external messaging is used anywhere in the flow.

requirements.text: If adding new persistent backend state to support security questions changes stable data structures, add/adjust backend upgrade migration logic according to the project’s conditional migration policy so upgrades do not trap or lose existing user profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading the canister preserves existing userProfiles data.
New security-question state initializes safely for existing users (treated as “not set up”).
No migration file is added unless it is necessary for an upgrade-safe schema/state change.

constraints: Do not implement a custom username/password authentication system; Internet Identity remains the only sign-in mechanism.

Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything inside frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
Do not add any email-based password reset or outbound email integration.
nonGoals: Resetting or recovering an Internet Identity account/password (outside the app’s control).
Unauthenticated account recovery (since the app relies on Internet Identity authentication).
Adding real-time messaging, SMS, push notifications, or third-party auth providers.
